concept_gloss.applicability: Genel konumsal çekirdeği ve hayvan, araç ya da nesnelerdeki özel ön bölüm adlarını birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: İlk olma, önde bulunma ve buna bağlı ön bölüm örneklerini korur.

concept_gloss.text: bir şeyin ilk veya öndeki bölümü

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin ilk, önde bulunan veya öne çıkan bölümü ya da üyesidir. Atların boyunları veya ilk sırası, yaban hayvanlarının öncüleri, okun ucu, koyunun boynu ve sahibinin önünde ilerleyen değnek bu konumsal çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir bütünün ilk veya önde bulunan bölümü ya da üyesidir.
Atların boyunlarını veya ilk sırasını ve yaban hayvanlarının önde gidenlerini adlandırır.
Okun ucunu ve koyunun boynunu, öndeki parçalar olmaları bakımından adlandırır.
Önden ilerleyen değnek veya kılavuz, önde bulunma yoluyla başkasına yön gösterir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir hayvan topluluğunun ilk sırasını veya önde ilerleyen üyelerini anlatan bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Tek bir nesnenin ön parçasını ve ok ucu ya da boyun gibi özel adları kapsamaz.
error_profile.preserves: Topluluğun önünde bulunma ve ilk sırayı oluşturma yönünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesne veya hayvan gövdesindeki önde bulunan parçanın adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Öncü grup ve önden giderek yol gösterme kullanımını belirtmez.
error_profile.preserves: Bir bütünün önde bulunan parçası olma yönünü korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek öncülük etmek değil, önde veya ilk sırada bulunmaktır; yol gösterme yalnızca uygun örneklerde buna bağlanır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü temel olarak bir şeyin ilk veya önde bulunan bölümünü bildirir; yol gösterme, bazı öndekilerin başkalarına öncülük etmesinden doğan bağlı bir açıklamadır. Bu nedenle dal korunabilir, ancak her öndeki parçanın yol gösterdiği düşünülmemelidir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir şeyin ilki veya öndeki bölümü
atların boyunları ya da ilk sırası; yaban hayvanlarının öncüleri

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel olarak ilk veya öndeki şey anlamı ile atların, yaban hayvanlarının, okun ve koyunun belirli ön parçalarını adlandıran kullanımlar ayrı tutulur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün öncülük, ilk sıra ve ön bölüm adayları değerlendirildi; genel ön bölüm komşusu sınırı en doğrudan açıkladığı için yayımlandı.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal önde giden üyeleri ve kaynakta sayılan özel ön parçaları toplar; komşu dal ise ön, üst ve başlangıç konumunu daha genel biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Önde bulunmanın bazı örneklerde gruba öncülük etmesi ve belirli hayvan parçalarını adlandırması bu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Önün yanı sıra üst bölüm ve bir yarışta göğüsle öne geçme komşu dalın daha geniş alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir bütünün başlangıçta veya ön tarafta bulunan bölümünü adlandırır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الهادي من كل شيء أوله؛ هوادي الخيل أعناقها أو أول رعيل؛ العصا هاديا لأنها تتقدمه؛ الدليل يسمى هاديا لتقدمه (ayn)؛ هادي السهم نصله؛ الهادي العنق؛ هوادي الخيل أعناقها أو أول رعيل؛ الهاديات أوائل الوحش (sihah)؛ الهادية من كل شيء أوله وما تقدم منه؛ هادية الشاة الرقبة؛ هوادي الخيل أعناقها أو أول رعيل؛ هاديات الوحش أوائلها (tahdhib)؛ هوادي الوحش متقدماتها الهادية لغيرها (mufradat)؛ كل متقدم لذلك هاد؛ هوادي الخيل أعناقها؛ هاديها أول رعيل؛ الهادية العصا لأنها تتقدم ممسكها (maqayis)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bir şeyin ilk ve öndeki bölümünde birleşir; atların boynu ya da ilk sırası, yaban hayvanlarının öncüleri, koyun boynu, ok ucu ve önde ilerleyen değnek bu konumsal çekirdeği farklı nesnelerde gerçekleştirir. Önden giden kılavuz da aynı konumsal ilişkiyle adlandırılır.

error_profile.preserves: Armağanı, incelik amacını, verme eylemini ve karşılıklılığı birlikte korur.

concept_map.definition: Sevgi veya yakınlık duyulan birine incelik ve iyilik göstergesi olarak bir şey gönderme ya da verme ve verilen şeydir. Karşılıklı armağanlaşma, sunma tabağı ve bunu sık yapan kişi bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Sevgi veya yakınlık duyulan birine incelik göstergesi olarak verilen şeydir.

Armağanın üzerine konduğu tabağı ve sık armağan veren kişiyi adlandırır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yakınlık ve incelik göstergesi olarak verilen nesnenin adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda en doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.loses: Verme eylemini, karşılıklılığı, sunma tabağını ve sık veren kişi anlamını kapsamaz.
error_profile.preserves: İncelik amacıyla verilen şey olma çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsanların birbirlerine karşılıklı olarak armağan verdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Tek armağanın adını, sunma tabağını ve sık veren kişi anlamını belirtmez.
error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklı armağan verme ilişkisini ve yakınlık yönünü korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Sıradan mal aktarımı değil, incelik ve yakınlık işareti olan armağan esastır; kutsal yere adanan sunu ayrı daldadır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü sevgi bağı bulunan birine incelik ve iyilik amacıyla gönderilen armağanı, karşılıklı armağan vermeyi, armağanın sunulduğu tabağı ve sık armağan veren kişiyi açıkça kapsar. Dal çerçevesi bütün bu türevleri doğru sınırlar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak armağan ve armağan verme alanı tanımlanır; kutsal amaçlı sunu, gelini eşine götürme ve şiirsel atışma anlamları içeri alınmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün armağan, bağış ve iyilik adayları değerlendirildi; incelik amaçlı armağana en yakın sınırı veren aday seçildi.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Karşılıklı verme, armağan tabağı ve sık armağan veren kişi bu dalın türev alanındadır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da birine yakınlık ve iyilik göstergesi olarak sunulan armağanı anlatır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الهدية ما أهديت إلى ذي مودة من بر (ayn)؛ الهدية واحدة الهدايا؛ أهديت له وإليه؛ المهدى ما يهدى فيه؛ التهادي أن يهدي بعضهم إلى بعض؛ المهداء الذي من عادته أن يهدي (sihah)؛ أهديت الهدية إهداء؛ امرأة مهداء؛ المهدى الطبق الذي يهدى عليه (tahdhib)؛ الهدية مختصة باللطف؛ المهدى الطبق؛ المهداء من يكثر إهداء الهدية (mufradat)؛ الهدية ما أهديت من لطف إلى ذي مودة؛ المهدي الطبق تهدى عليه (maqayis)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الهدية والهدايا والإهداء بمعنى العطية اللطيفة إلى ذي مودة والتهادي بين الناس والمهدى الطبق والمهداء كثير الإهداء
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الهدي المهدى إلى الحرم ولا العروس المهدية إلى زوجها ولا المهاداة الشعرية إذا أريدت مهاجاة متبادلة

concept_gloss.text: kutsal yere adanan hayvan, mal veya eşya

concept_map.definition: Kutsal eve veya bölgeye yakınlık kazanma amacıyla ayrılıp gönderilen hayvan, mal ya da eşyadır. Kimi anlatımlar bunu özellikle büyükbaş hayvanlara bağlar; develerin genel olarak aynı adla anılması ise bu kullanımdan genişlemedir.

facets.statement: Kutsal bir hedefe yakınlık amacıyla ayrılıp gönderilen sunudur.
Sununun kapsamı kimi anlatımlarda büyükbaş hayvanlarla sınırlı, kimilerinde mal ve eşyayı da içerecek kadar geniştir.
Develerin genel olarak bu adla anılması, kutsal yere gönderilen deve sunusundan gelişen bir genişlemedir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kutsal bölgeye gönderilen sununun özellikle büyükbaş bir hayvan olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Mal ve eşyanın da sunu olabildiği geniş kaynak kapsamını dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.preserves: Kutsal hedefe yakınlık amacıyla ayrılan hayvan yönünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Adın kutsal sunu bağından genişleyerek genel deve topluluğunu anlattığı kullanımda uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Kutsal hedef, adama amacı ve başka tür sunular bu kısa karşılıkta görünmez.
error_profile.preserves: Develere uzanan adlandırma genişlemesini doğrudan korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal insanlar arasındaki sıradan armağanı değil, kutsal bir hedefe yaklaşma amacıyla ayrılıp gönderilen sunuyu anlatır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü kutsal eve veya bölgeye yakınlaşma amacıyla gönderilen hayvanı, malı ya da eşyayı bildirir; bazı anlatımlar alanı özellikle büyükbaş hayvanlarla sınırlar, bazıları daha geniş tutar. Dal çerçevesi bu kapsam değişkenliğini ve deveye uzanan kullanımı korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kutsal bölgeye adanan hayvan, mal veya eşya
adanmış sunu adından genişleyen deve adı

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak adanmış sunu anlamı tanımlanır; sıradan armağan, ibadete giriş ve kutsal yolculuğun kendisi bu dala katılmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: İbadet, ziyaret, kesim, sunu ve hazırlık adaylarının tümü değerlendirildi; en açıklayıcı genel amaç ile somut sunu ayrımı yayımlandı.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal gönderilen somut sunuyu ve hedefini sınırlar; komşu dal ise aynı amaçla yapılan eylemleri ve kullanılan araçları genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kutsal hedefe gönderilen belirli hayvan, mal veya eşya ve bundan gelişen deve adı bu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yakınlık amacıyla yapılan her türlü eylem ve kullanılan her türlü araç komşu dalın daha geniş alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kutsal yakınlık elde etmek amacıyla sunulan veya yapılan şeyi kapsar.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الهدي والهدي ما أهديت إلى مكة؛ كل شيء تهديه من مال أو متاع فهو هدي (ayn)؛ الهدي ما يهدى إلى الحرم من النعم؛ مالى هدي؛ حتى يبلغ الهدى محله (sihah)؛ أهديت الهدي إلى بيت الله؛ الهدي خفيف وعليه هدية أي بدنة؛ ما يهدى إلى مكة من النعم وغيره من مال أو متاع؛ العرب تسمي الإبل هديا (tahdhib)؛ الهدي مختص بما يهدى إلى البيت؛ فما استيسر من الهدي؛ هديا بالغ الكعبة (mufradat)؛ الهدي والهدي ما أهدي من النعم إلى الحرم قربة إلى الله تعالى (maqayis)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kutsal hedefe yakınlık amacıyla gönderilen sunuda birleşir; kapsamın yalnızca büyükbaş hayvanlar mı yoksa mal ve eşya da mı olduğu değişir, develerin genel adı olarak kullanım da bu çekirdekten genişler.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الهدي أو الهدي المشدد والمخفف بمعنى ما يهدى إلى مكة أو الحرم أو بيت الله من النعم أو المال أو المتاع قربة وما توسع منه إلى البدنة والإبل
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الهدية العادية بين الناس ولا مجرد الدلالة والإرشاد

concept_gloss.applicability: Götürme eylemini, olayın adını ve götürülen gelin katılımcısını aynı çekirdek altında temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Gelini eşine götürme, birleştirme ve götürülen gelin katılımcısını korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir gelini eşinin yanına götürmek, onunla bir araya getirip ona katmak ve bu götürülme olayıdır. Aynı alan, eşine götürülen gelinin kendisini de adlandırır.

facets.statement: Gelini eşinin yanına götürme ve onunla bir araya getirme eylemidir.
Gelinin eşine götürülmesi olayının adı olarak kullanılır.
Eşinin yanına götürülen gelinin kendisini adlandırır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylemin kendisinin anlatıldığı etkin cümlelerde doğal Türkçe karşılıktır.

error_profile.loses: Olay adını ve götürülen gelinin adlandırılmasını tek başına karşılamaz.
error_profile.preserves: Gelinin eşinin yanına götürülmesi eylemini açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylemden etkilenen gelinin adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Götürme eylemini ve olayın adını doğrudan ifade etmez.
error_profile.preserves: Götürülen gelin katılımcısını ve varış ilişkisini korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal evliliğin tamamını veya eş olma durumunu değil, gelinin eşinin yanına götürülmesi aşamasını anlatır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü gelini eşinin yanına götürme, bir araya getirip katma eylemini, bu eylemin adını ve götürülen gelinin adlandırılmasını birlikte verir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu olay ve katılımcı ayrımını doğru korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Gelini eşine götürme ve götürülen gelin anlamları tanımlanır; armağan verme ya da düğünün bütün aşamaları bu dala taşınmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Eş, evlilik, düğün, gelin taşıma ve evliliksizlik adayları değerlendirildi; aynı olay aşamasını paylaşan en yakın komşu seçildi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal götürme eylemi ile gelin katılımcısını adlandırır; komşu dal aynı olayın tören, taşıma ve taşıt yönlerini daha ayrıntılı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Eşine götürülen gelinin edilgen adla anılması ve birleştirme ilişkisi bu dalda belirgindir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Düğün alayı, gelini taşıma ve gelinin taşındığı kapalı taşıt komşu dalın alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da gelinin eşinin yanına götürülmesi aşamasını anlatır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الهداء مصدر قولك هديت المرأة إلى زوجها؛ وهي مهدية وهدي (sihah)؛ هديت العروس فأنا أهديها هداء؛ أهدى الرجل امرأته جمعها إليه وضمها؛ المرأة سميت هديا لأنها كالأسيرة عند زوجها أو لأنها تهدى إلى زوجها (tahdhib)؛ الهدي يقال في العروس؛ هديت العروس إلى زوجها (mufradat)؛ الهدى العروس وقد هديت إلى بعلها هداء (maqayis)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gelini eşine götürme ve onunla birleştirme eyleminde birleşir; eylem adı ile götürülen gelini belirten edilgen adlandırma aynı olay yapısına bağlanır. Gelin adının eşine götürülmeden veya kocasının yanında tutsak benzeri sayılmasından doğduğu yönünde iki açıklama aktarılır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه هديت المرأة أو العروس إلى زوجها وهداؤها وكونها مهدية أو هدي في معنى مفعول
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الهدية العادية ولا الهدي إلى الحرم إلا من جهة أصل الإرسال

concept_gloss.applicability: Ana kişi türünü ve onunla birleştirilmemesi gereken tutsak varyantını birlikte görünür kılar.

error_profile.preserves: Sığınma, güvence ve dokunulmazlık çekirdeğiyle tutsak varyantını ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluktan sığınma veya güvence isteyen ve bu yüzden dokunulmaz sayılan erkektir. Bazı kaynak açıklamalarında aynı ad tutsak erkek için de kullanılır.

facets.statement: Bir topluluğa sığınan veya onlardan güvence alan, dokunulmazlığı bulunan erkektir.
Bazı kaynak açıklamalarında aynı ad tutsak erkek için kullanılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğa sığınıp onlardan güvence isteyen kişinin anlatıldığı ana kullanımda uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Aynı ad için aktarılan tutsak açıklamasını dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.preserves: Sığınan kişinin güvence istemesini ve dokunulmaz sayılmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca bazı kaynak açıklamalarının aynı kişi adını tutsak için kullandığı bağlamda geçerlidir.

error_profile.loses: Dokunulmaz sığınmacı ve güvence ilişkisini bütünüyle dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.preserves: Ayrı kaynak varyantındaki tutsak kişi anlamını korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dokunulmaz sığınmacı çekirdektir; tutsak anlamı ortak bir tanım değil, açıkça ayrılması gereken kaynak varyantıdır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü öncelikle bir topluluktan sığınma veya güvence isteyen ve kutsal sunuya benzer dokunulmazlığı bulunan erkeği anlatır; bazı açıklamalar aynı biçimi tutsak için de verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak sığınmacı ile tutsak tek bir durum gibi birleştirilmemelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak kişi adı, dokunulmaz sığınmacı çekirdeği ve tutsak varyantıyla tanımlanır; kutsal sunu veya gelin anlamı buraya alınmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Dokunulmazlık, güvence, sığınma, korunma ve tutsaklık adayları değerlendirildi; kişi adı ile koruma olayı arasındaki en açıklayıcı ilişki seçildi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal olayın dokunulmaz kişi katılımcısını adlandırır; komşu dal ise sığınma ve koruma ilişkisinin eylem ve durum yapısını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal güvence isteyen dokunulmaz kişiyi adlandırır ve ayrıca tutsak varyantı taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal sığınma isteme, güvence verme, koruma ve zulümden kurtarma olayının bütününü anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir kişinin bir topluluktan güvence istemesi ve onların korumasına girmesi alanını paylaşır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الرجل الذي له حرمة كحرمة هدي البيت؛ يقال للأسير أيضا هدي (sihah)؛ الهدي الرجل ذو الحرمة وهو أن يأتي القوم يستجيرهم أو يأخذ منهم عهدا؛ يقال للأسير أيضا الهدي (tahdhib)؛ وقيل الهدي الأسير (maqayis)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak anlatımı, güvence isteyen ve kutsal sunuya benzer dokunulmazlığı bulunan erkeği öne çıkarır; tutsak anlamı ise aynı ad için aktarılan ayrı bir açıklama olarak korunur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الهدي للرجل ذي الحرمة المستجير أو الآخذ عهدا قبل أن يجار وللأسير في بعض الأقوال
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الهدي القرباني إلا من جهة التشبيه بحرمة هدي البيت ولا العروس إلا في تفسير محتمل عند تهذيب اللغة

concept_gloss.applicability: Genel yalpalama hareketini ve güçsüzlüğe bağlı iki kişiden destek alma yapısını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Sallanma, yürüme, güçsüzlük koşulu ve başkalarına dayanma öğelerini korur.

concept_map.definition: Yürürken sağa sola sallanmak veya yalpalamaktır. Güçsüz bir kişinin iki kişi arasında ilerleyip ikisine dayanması bunun özel yapısıdır; kadınların ve ağır develerin yürüyüşü örneklenir.

facets.statement: Yürüyüş sırasında sağa sola sallanma ve yalpalama hareketidir.
Güçsüz kişinin iki kişi arasında yürüyerek her ikisine dayanması özel yapıdır.
Kadınların ve ağır develerin sallantılı yürüyüşü bu hareketin örnekleri olarak verilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sağa sola sallanan yürüyüş biçiminin genel olarak anlatıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Güçsüzlük nedeniyle iki kişiye dayanma yapısını belirtmez.
error_profile.preserves: Yürüyüşte sağa sola sallanma ve dengesiz ilerleme yönünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Güçsüz kişinin iki destekçi arasında ilerlediği özel söz diziminde uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Desteksiz sallantılı yürüyüşün genel kapsamını dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.preserves: İki kişiden destek almayı ve güçsüzlük koşulunu açıkça korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek sallantılı yürüyüştür; iki kişiye dayanma güçsüzlük koşuluna bağlı özel bir yapıdır ve armağan alışverişiyle ilişkili değildir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü sağa sola sallanarak yürümeyi ve güçsüz kişinin iki kişiye dayanarak yürümesini açıkça ayırır; kadınların ve ağır develerin yürüyüşü örnek olarak verilir. Dal çerçevesi hareket, dayanak ve neden ayrımlarını korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Sallanarak yürüme biçimi ile iki kişi arasında onlara dayanarak yürüme kalıbı ayrı yüzler olarak tanımlanır; dayanak koşulu bütün kullanımlara yayılmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Güçsüzlük, sallanma, aksak yürüyüş, yaslanma ve beden duruşu adayları değerlendirildi; hareket biçimi ile destek ilişkisini en iyi ayıran iki komşu yayımlandı.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal desteğe ihtiyaç duyulan güçsüz yürüyüşü de kapsayan fiziksel hareket biçimidir; komşu dal hareketi gösteriş ve kırıtma çağrışımıyla sınırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Güçsüzlükten iki kişiye dayanma ve ağır develerin sallantılı yürüyüşü bu dalın kapsamındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Gösterişli kırıtma ve ahlaki yargı taşıyan kadın betimlemesi komşu dalın özel alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yürürken bedenin sağa sola salınmasını veya kıvrılarak ilerlemesini anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal desteği sallantılı ilerleyişin içinde kurar; komşu dal ise hareketten bağımsız genel yaslanma ve dayanma durumunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yürüyüş sırasında sallanma ve iki kişinin arasında ilerleme bu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yürüme gerektirmeyen genel yaslanma, değneğe yüklenme ve dayanma düzeni komşu dalın alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da beden ağırlığını bir dış desteğe vererek dengede kalmayı içerebilir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: التهادي مشي في تمايل يمينا وشمالا كمشي النساء والإبل الثقال (ayn)؛ يهادي بين اثنين إذا كان يمشي بينهما معتمدا عليهما من ضعفه وتمايله؛ المرأة إذا تمايلت في مشيتها قيل تهادى (sihah)؛ يهادى بين اثنين معناه يعتمد عليهما من ضعفه وتمايله؛ هي تهادى إذا تمايلت في مشيها (tahdhib)؛ يهادي بين اثنين إذا مشى بينهما معتمدا عليهما؛ تهادت المرأة إذا مشت مشي الهدي (mufradat)؛ جاء فلان يهادي بين اثنين إذا كان يمشي بينهما معتمدا عليهما (maqayis)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sallantılı yürüyüş ile güçsüzlük yüzünden iki kişiye dayanarak ilerleme yapısında birleşir; kadın ve ağır deve yürüyüşleri çekirdeği açıklayan örneklerdir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه يهادي بين اثنين إذا مشى معتمدا عليهما من ضعف وتمايل وتهادت المرأة إذا تمايلت في مشيتها ومشي النساء والإبل الثقال
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه التهادي بمعنى تبادل الهدايا ولا الهدي بمعنى السكون دون تمايل

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişinin zihinsel yavaşlığını, bedensel güçsüzlüğünü ve uyuşuk ağırlığını birlikte nitelemek için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bönlük, güçsüzlük, ağırlık ve uyuşukluk özelliklerinin tümünü korur.

concept_map.definition: Bön, güçsüz, ağır ve uyuşuk erkek için kullanılan olumsuz bir nitelemedir.

facets.statement: Bir erkeği bön ve kavrayışı yavaş olarak niteler.
Aynı kişiyi güçsüz, ağır ve uyuşuk olarak niteler.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin hareket ve tepki bakımından ağır oluşunun öne çıktığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Bönlük ve güçsüzlük özelliklerini bütünüyle belirtmez.
error_profile.preserves: Kişiye yüklenen ağırlık ve uyuşukluk nitelemesini korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bir kişiye yönelik olumsuz nitelemedir; gelini eşine götürme olay adıyla veya sakin ve düzgün tutumla karıştırılmaz.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü bir erkeği bön ve güçsüz, ayrıca ağır ve uyuşuk olarak niteleyen kişi adlarını verir. Dal çerçevesi zihinsel yavaşlık, bedensel güçsüzlük ve ağırlık özelliklerini doğru biçimde toplar.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bön, güçsüz, ağır ve uyuşuk adam

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak kişi nitelemesi tanımlanır; aynı ses yapısındaki gelin götürme olay adı ve sakinlik anlamı buraya taşınmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Ağırlık, güçsüzlük, bönlük, tembellik ve gevşeklik adayları değerlendirildi; kişi nitelemesiyle genel ağırlığı ayıran komşu seçildi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal özellikleri bön ve güçsüz bir erkek nitelemesinde birleştirir; komşu dal ağırlık ve yavaşlığı kişiden başka durumlara da yayar.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bönlük ve güçsüzlükle birlikte belirli bir erkeği adlandıran kalıcı niteleme bu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yemek, hastalık, uyku, beden veya genel hareket için kullanılan ağırlık ve yavaşlık komşu dalın geniş alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bedensel veya davranışsal ağırlık, yavaşlık ve uyuşukluk özelliklerini paylaşır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الهداء الرجل البليد الضعيف (ayn)؛ رجل هداء وهدان للثقيل الوخم (tahdhib)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak anlatımı olumsuz bir erkek nitelemesinde bönlük ve güçsüzlüğü, ağırlık ve uyuşuklukla birlikte verir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الهداء أو الهدان للرجل البليد الضعيف أو الثقيل الوخم
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الهداء مصدر هديت المرأة إلى زوجها ولا الهدي بمعنى السكون

concept_gloss.applicability: Telasşsız hareketi ve buna eşlik eden güzel görünür tutumu birlikte anlatan bütün çekirdek için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sakinlik, telaşsızlık, ölçülü ilerleme ve düzgün tutum öğelerini korur.

concept_map.definition: Bozguna uğramış birinin telaşlı kaçışına benzemeyen sakin, ölçülü ve düzgün ilerleyiş ya da görünür tutumdur.

facets.statement: Hareket ve tutumda sakinlik ve telaşsızlık bildirir.
Sakinliğe düzgün ve güzel bir görünür tutum eşlik eder.
Bozguna uğramış kişinin acele kaçışı, bu sakin ilerleyişin karşı örneğidir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin acele etmeden, görünüşünü bozmadan ilerlediği bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.loses: Yürüyüş dışındaki genel davranış ve tutum kapsamını daraltır.
error_profile.preserves: Sakin ilerlemeyi ve güzel görünür tutumu birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal salt hareketsizlik değildir; telaşsız ilerleme ve düzgün görünür tutum birlikte bulunur.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü sakinlik ile bozgun halinde kaçan kişinin telaşlı hızından uzak, düzgün ve güzel bir yürüyüş ya da tutumu birlikte verir. Dal çerçevesi sakinliği tek başına bırakmayıp görünüş ve davranış niteliğiyle bağlar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak sakin ve düzgün tutum anlamı tanımlanır; başka kökteki durulma eylemi veya genel yaşam tarzı anlamları eklenmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sakinlik, yumuşaklık, ağırbaşlılık, rahatlık ve güzel görünüş adayları değerlendirildi; hareket ve tutum sınırını en iyi gösteren komşu seçildi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal sakinliği kişinin düzgün ilerleyişi ve görünür tutumuyla sınırlar; komşu dal sakinliği doğaya, yaşama ve türlü eylemlere yayar.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bozgun kaçışının tersine ölçülü ilerleme ve güzel görünür tutum bu dalın belirgin sınırıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Denizin durgunluğu ile yaşam veya eylemin sıkıntısız, sertliksiz oluşu komşu dalın daha geniş kapsamındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da acele, sertlik ve kaygıdan uzak sakin bir hareket ya da davranışı anlatır.

text.arabic_uthmani: ۞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرَّسُولُ بَلِّغْ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ۖ وَإِن لَّمْ تَفْعَلْ فَمَا بَلَّغْتَ رِسَالَتَهُۥ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْصِمُكَ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

baseline.text: Ey elçi! Rabbinden sana indirileni bildir. Bunu yapmazsan onun mesajını iletmiş olmazsın. Allah seni insanlardan korur. Şüphesiz Allah inkâr eden topluluğu doğru yola iletmez.

findings.text: Bir mesaj, sınırına kadar ulaştırıldığında gerçek bir görev haline gelir.
Allah'ın koruması, elçinin mesajı bütünüyle açığa çıkarabilmesi için tutunacağı sağlamlığı sağlar.

activation_trace.role: Joins the commissioned carrier and the carried communication into one relay.
Supplies arrival at a limit and makes actual endpoint completion the test of the doubled verb.
Supplies caused downward delivery as the upstream movement that the messenger must continue.

changed_reading.after: Complete an entrusted relay so that what was sent down actually reaches its endpoint; withholding any part breaks the commission rather than merely diminishing it.
changed_reading.before: State the revealed content to the audience.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بَلِّغْ مَا أُنزِلَ ... فَمَا بَلَّغْتَ رِسَالَتَهُ
baseline_models.mechanism: A dispatched communication descends into the messenger's custody and must be carried all the way to its destination. Repeating ب ل غ across command and counterfactual makes endpoint arrival constitutive of the commission: an incomplete relay is treated as no relay.

activation_trace.role: Supplies release and outward dispatch as the motion that must remain open.
Supplies a preventing hold that preserves the carrier while transmission proceeds.
Locates the danger in the manifest human social field through which the relay must pass.

changed_reading.after: God holds the messenger-channel against human interruption so that the message, unlike its carrier, can be released fully into the human field.
changed_reading.before: God keeps the messenger safe from people.

baseline_models.mechanism: The verse coordinates opposite motions: the communication is released outward while its carrier is held against interruption. Protection is therefore functional containment of the transmitting channel, not withdrawal of the messenger from human exposure.

activation_trace.role: Marks objective arrival at the communicative endpoint.
Supplies gentle orientation toward a path as a distinct reception process.
Supplies active obstruction of acknowledged truth as the barrier to guided uptake.
Makes the reception problem collective and social rather than merely private.

changed_reading.after: Complete arrival and guided uptake are separate events: the first is demanded of the messenger even where collective truth-covering blocks the second.
changed_reading.before: Successful delivery should be evidenced by the audience becoming guided.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَمَا بَلَّغْتَ رِسَالَتَهُ ... لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus distinguishes external arrival from internal orientation. The messenger is accountable for making the communication reach; gentle direction can still fail where a collective actively covers the truth, so hostile uptake is not the measure of completed conveyance.

activation_trace.role: Keeps communicative arrival independently testable despite hostile audience transformations.
Supplies an openly raised call as the public transmission exposed to response.
Supplies appropriation, making ridicule an active capture of the call rather than mere inattention.
Converts the received call into derision and thereby changes its social presentation.
Removes serious purpose from the call and supplies a second mode of semantic interception.
Supplies concealment of the hearer's interior state, separating declared reception from actual uptake.

changed_reading.after: Complete arrival must remain unmistakable when hearers actively capture the call into ridicule or conceal their response; their recoding cannot redefine whether the messenger completed the relay.
changed_reading.before: Complete arrival is required even when uptake fails.

context_deltas.mechanism: The destination is not passive: a public call can be appropriated into mockery and purposeless play, while an interior posture can be concealed behind a declaration. Complete conveyance must therefore remain publicly legible even when hearers recode or hide their response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a public call recoded as play and an interior condition concealed; I treat these as two interception mechanisms against which completed delivery must stay independently auditable. A live alternative is that both are only post-delivery reactions and do not affect the shape of conveyance itself.
structural_cues: 5:57-58 repeat the taking of religion and the public call as mockery and play; 5:61 then contrasts a spoken claim of belief with what is hidden.

activation_trace.role: Makes omission the absence of an effect-producing act rather than a neutral pause.
Supplies the missing act of checking and restraining wrongdoing.
Locates the omission among holders of learned religious authority and sharpens the office-versus-action contrast.
Treats repeated wrongdoing as something socially produced, which responsible speech should interrupt.

changed_reading.after: Not conveying would reproduce the institutional failure just exposed: an office becomes empty when its holder does not actively interrupt concealment and harmful production.
changed_reading.before: Not conveying would leave an assigned communication unfinished.

context_deltas.mechanism: Learned office without restraining intervention becomes a countermodel for the messenger's commission. The focus conditional on not acting makes transmission an enacted responsibility: title, knowledge, and criticism are insufficient if they do not interrupt a harmful social production.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed learned restraint and the focus's action conditional; I infer an office-level contrast in which delivery is the messenger's required intervention. The alternative is that the rebuke of learned authorities and the messenger's command are adjacent but functionally independent.
structural_cues: 5:62 condemns what people do, 5:63 condemns learned authorities for not restraining what is said and consumed, and 5:67 defines the messenger's commission through the consequence of not acting.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the outward release that protection must permit rather than restrain.
Supplies a fastening support by which the carrier remains secured under pressure.
Provides the concrete image of a limb-binding restraint and raises the question of what is wrongly or rightly held.
Provides the counter-motion of extending and releasing a hand, matching an unobstructed outgoing channel.
Supplies recurrent ignition as the conflict process threatening continuity of transmission.
Names the hostile field in which the protected relay must operate.
Supplies divine quenching as a contextual precedent for containing interruption without suppressing the message.

changed_reading.after: Protection is selective conflict containment: it secures the carrier and quenches interruption while leaving the outgoing message fully extended and unbound.
changed_reading.before: Protection is a general preventing hold on harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pre-focus context materializes selective restraint through bound and extended hands, then recurring war-fires and their extinguishing. At the focus, the message is the element released, while divine holding prevents the human conflict field from closing the transmitting channel.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restraint/release imagery and divine quenching of recurrent conflict; I align those motions with the focus's released message and held messenger. The alternative is that the hand imagery concerns provision and the fire imagery communal war without specifying the mechanism of 5:67 protection.
structural_cues: Within the pre-focus movement, 5:64 pairs bound and outspread hands and repeatedly ignited war with divine extinguishing before 5:67 pairs dispatch with protection.

activation_trace.role: Defines the messenger-side responsibility as delivering the communication.
Supplies active rising to undertake an order as the recipient-side responsibility.
Identifies the established material as the same kind of caused delivery that enters the focus relay.
Repeats active undertaking after the focus and places the obligation in a collective social setting.
Repeats caused delivery on both the recipient and messenger sides, binding the flanking passages together.

changed_reading.after: The messenger is accountable for making revelation reach, while recipients are separately accountable for making it stand in practice; their failure cannot retroactively turn his completed relay into non-delivery.
changed_reading.before: The messenger alone is charged with completing the movement of revelation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is a hinge between recipient establishment and messenger transmission. The same descending material is at issue on both sides, but the verbs divide accountability: the messenger must make it reach, while recipients must stand it up as an operative order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated descent phrases and distinct obligation verbs; I infer a division of responsibility in which conveyance enables but does not substitute for establishment. A live alternative is that the repetition supplies topical emphasis without a formal sender-recipient division.
structural_cues: 5:66 and 5:68 flank the focus with near-repetitions of what was sent down from their or your Lord, while establishment belongs to recipients and conveyance belongs to the messenger.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the preserving hold whose functional object is clarified by the later envoy hazard.
Places envoy sending inside an affirmed covenant rather than an optional communication.
Repeats dispatch across plural and singular carriers and turns the focus commission into one link in a sequence.
Supplies resistant self-inclination as the motive that opposes the arriving message.
Supplies denial as one recurrent response to the envoy chain.
Supplies lethal interruption as the extreme hazard against which protected completion becomes salient.
Returns to carrier and message language and normalizes the focus messenger within a succession.
Supplies the passing of earlier carriers, making continuity of the communication exceed any one messenger.

changed_reading.after: God preserves this commissioned link long enough to complete the relay despite the established pattern of desire-driven denial and lethal interruption; protection serves continuity of mission.
changed_reading.before: God prevents people from harming the messenger while he delivers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus envoy sequence establishes a recurrent hazard: commissioned carriers bring what selves resist and are denied or killed, while later messengers pass in succession. Protection in the focus therefore secures completion of this relay inside a known rejection pattern, rather than promising an opposition-free mission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a covenantal envoy chain, resistant desire, denial, killing, and succession; I infer that 5:67 protection guarantees completion within this pattern rather than absence of all opposition. The alternative is a broader personal safety promise whose relation to the chain is only thematic.
structural_cues: 5:70 replays sending and messenger language three times shortly after the focus and joins it to denial and killing; 5:75 again places one messenger among messengers who passed.

activation_trace.role: Supplies gentle path-indication whose failure the later sequence decomposes.
Supplies covering as the common operation linking the later modes of closure.
Supplies loss of inner sight as one blocked input to guidance.
Supplies refusal or loss of hearing as a second blocked input.
Supplies reversal away from a disclosed orientation rather than lack of disclosure.
Supplies deliberate trailing behind a chosen leader of movement.
Identifies self-inclination as the substitute guide being followed.
Supplies repeated route-loss as the outcome of sensory closure and desire-led following.

changed_reading.after: Non-guidance is rendered as failed uptake after indication: inner sight and hearing close, signs are reversed, desire becomes the followed guide, and the route is repeatedly lost.
changed_reading.before: The truth-covering collective is not gently directed to the path.

context_deltas.mechanism: The non-guidance clause acquires a staged reception mechanism: inner sight is lost, hearing is stopped, disclosed signs are turned away from their orientation, and desire is followed into route-loss. Covering is thus enacted through sensory and volitional closure after indication is available.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sensory closure, reversal, following desire, and repeated route-loss; I infer a causal reception sequence behind the focus's non-guidance. A live alternative is that these are parallel consequences of covering rather than the mechanism by which guided uptake fails.
structural_cues: 5:71 repeats blindness and deafness, 5:75 pairs displayed signs with being turned away, and 5:77 repeats straying around the command not to follow desires.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the delivery act whose bodily and social instrument is activated by the later tongue.
Explicitly makes the tongue an instrument for carrying a message and gives the focus command a bodily conduit.
Supplies departure from obedience as the condition to which consequential speech responds.
Supplies the omitted verbal intervention that should check an ongoing act.
Marks the act as recognizably reprehensible and properly subject to restraint.
Repeats effect-producing action around failed restraint and mirrors the focus conditional on not acting.

changed_reading.after: Delivery is a consequential tongue-action that interrupts normalized wrong; refusing that speech is itself an operative failure, not an absence of action.
changed_reading.before: The messenger must perform the assigned act of delivery.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later tongue and mutual-restraint sequence turns conveyance into accountable speech-action. A tongue carries consequential communication, while failure to restrain a recognized wrong lets that wrong continue to be made; the focus's not-doing is therefore not neutral silence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a message-bearing tongue and a community that does not verbally restrain enacted wrong; I infer that commanded conveyance is a counter-action and that silence itself has effects. The alternative is that the tongue only identifies the historical vehicle of a curse and does not model the focus delivery.
structural_cues: 5:78-79 directly sequence tongue, disobedience, failure to restrain, recognized wrong, and two occurrences of doing.

activation_trace.role: Supplies preservation within exposure, now refined by the later range of human responses.
Repeats the manifest human field and ties the later comparison directly to the focus threat-domain.
Supplies one pole of the field as active enmity.
Supplies nearness as the spatial relation opening the opposite reception pole.
Supplies affection as the social force opposite enmity within the same human field.
Turns acoustic reception into understanding and responsive compliance.
Places the commissioned carrier at the center of the demonstrated reception sequence.
Supplies recognition by a distinguishing trace, showing content that has genuinely registered.
Converts recognized knowledge into overt testimony and completes a successful uptake path.

changed_reading.after: The messenger is preserved within a mixed human field so hostility cannot stop access to those who will hear, recognize, and testify; protection enables exposure rather than isolation.
changed_reading.before: The messenger is held safe against a generally hostile human collective.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human field from which the messenger is protected is sharply differentiated rather than uniformly hostile: it contains extreme enmity and near affection, followed by actual hearing, recognition, and testimony. Protection keeps the carrier present within this mixed field long enough for the relay to reach responsive hearers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed human dispositions and a complete reception sequence; I infer that protection from people means secured operation within a differentiated social field, not separation from humanity. The alternative is that 5:82-83 simply identifies exceptional recipients without revising the scope of protection.
structural_cues: 5:82 repeats people after the focus and pivots within one ayah from strongest enmity to nearest affection; 5:83 then stages revelation, messenger, hearing, recognition, and testimony.

remaining_uncertainties: The packet supports a mission-preservation reading of يَعْصِمُكَ, but does not settle how far that exhausts personal protection.
Mockery and concealment may be mechanisms that interfere with communicative arrival, or only hostile responses after arrival is already complete.
The nourishing-flow and guidance-warning readings depend on deliberately retained split-root or cross-domain activations and must remain exploratory.
strongest_changes: The flanking 5:66 and 5:68 repetitions divide responsibility between messenger-side conveyance and recipient-side establishment.
The restraint, release, and fire imagery of 5:64 turns protection into preservation of an open transmitting channel amid recurring conflict.
The envoy sequence of 5:70-75 makes protection serve completion and continuity inside a known pattern of denial and lethal interruption.
The sensory and volitional sequence of 5:71-77 explains failed guidance as closed uptake after indication rather than failed external delivery.
The pivot from enmity to affection and then hearing, recognition, and testimony in 5:82-83 differentiates the human field and shows why protection enables exposure.
summary.what_was_special: The focus coordinates three non-equivalent operations: revelation descends, the messenger makes it reach, and recipients may or may not let it orient them. Context turns divine protection into selective holding of the carrier so the communication remains released through institutional silence, semantic capture, conflict, and uneven human reception.

activation_trace.role: The split target contributes feeding and growth as an exploratory source-image for the communication.
Starts the material analogy with a caused downward delivery.
Makes the descending material continue until it reaches a receiving endpoint.
Turns established descent into received provision within the exploratory growth model.
Supplies easy abundant overflow as the embodied result of receptive hearing.
Supplies a vessel filled past capacity, making reception visibly overflow through the eye.
Extends momentary overflow into continuing circulation.
Gives the continuing flow a channel that cuts through and reshapes its receiving ground.

changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, a nourishing descent is relayed to a receiver, taken in, overfills the eye, and continues through a durable channel: conveyance behaves like circulation that produces growth rather than a single utterance.
changed_reading.before: The message is dispatched content that must reach its hearers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the packet's form-distant ر ب و target for ر ب ب with provision and liquid-flow images. It remains anchored to رَبِّكَ, أُنزِلَ, and بَلِّغْ and to the packet's descent, eating, overflowing, and river sequence; downstream prose should label it a material analogy for transmission and growth, not a lexical replacement for Lord or revelation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A message exists as mission only when it reaches its limit.** `ب ل غ B001` is reaching the limit and `B002` conveying; repetition makes incomplete conveyance equivalent to no conveyance. I infer that receipt imposes a terminal direction toward public delivery.
2. **Protection is a holdfast enabling exposure.** `ع ص م B001` is a protective restraining hold and `B002` a strap/holdfast. Placed after the uncompromised command, it does not prevent action but secures the messenger while action extends outward.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Delivery is defined by reaching the message’s limit.** Repeated fixed **ب ل غ / B001** (“reaching the limit”) and **B002** (“conveying a message”) make partial arrival functionally equivalent to non-delivery. The preceding ayat concern establishing all that was sent down, while 5:68 makes standing conditional on the same completeness. I infer that the message’s integrity is lost if fear stops it short of its assigned endpoint. The doubled construction reads as a completion criterion, not rhetorical redundancy.
2. **Protection supplies the hold needed for full transmission.** Fixed **ع ص م / B001** (“a restraining hold that protects”) follows the uncompromised command. I infer that divine protection blocks human pressure from shortening the route. Preservation here reads as enabling complete public conveyance, not withdrawal from exposure.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:68’s demand to establish all revelation and 5:70’s succession of messengers confirmed that delivery is measured by complete reach, not selective transmission.

words.gloss_range: vocative opening particle with expanded call force
words.prose: {{ar:يَٰٓ}} ({{tr:yā}}) widens the first beat into direct address before any command appears. Its extended call helps the summons arrive first, and the rare Surah 5 Messenger-address frame links this opening with the same formal address at 5:41.

topics.headline: expanded direct call before command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins with a widened summons before the duty is named.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on the layered opening call, the madd-expanded sound, and the rare Messenger-address frame in Surah 5.

words.gloss_range: vocative intermediary that points and alerts before the title completes the call
words.prose: {{ar:أَيُّهَا}} ({{tr:ayyuhā}}) works as the attention-and-vocative bridge that lets the definite title land as the called identity. The reader hears the address delay the named role until the title can complete the summons.

topics.headline: attention-and-apposition route to the title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the title is grammatically installed as the addressee, not loosely appended.
topics.reason: The rows identify the vocative noun, alerting particle, delayed title, and boundary shift into direct address.

words.gloss_range: definite role title foregrounding dispatched transmission
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلرَّسُولُ}} ({{tr:al-rasūlu}}) names the addressee by the office of transmission. The definite role noun makes the coming command fit the person addressed, and the same {{ar:ر س ل}} ({{tr:r-s-l}}) field returns in {{ar:رِسَالَتَهُۥ}} ({{tr:risālatahu}}), pairing sent person and sent message.
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:ر س ل}} ({{tr:r-s-l}}) ranges around sending, dispatching, and message-bearing; the local title selects the sent-transmitter role

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: same-root message noun paired with the Messenger title

topics.headline: Messenger title as durable transmission office
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressee is named by the delivery role that the command will immediately activate.
topics.reason: The title is definite, appositional, role-shaped, and locally echoed by the message noun; the 5:41 parallel supports the Surah 5 Messenger-address bracket.

words.gloss_range: causative imperative: make the revealed content reach its destination
words.prose: {{ar:بَلِّغْ}} ({{tr:balligh}}) is a Form II imperative: the Messenger must cause the revealed content to reach, not merely possess or mention it. The command governs the open object after it, and its root returns in {{ar:بَلَّغْتَ}} ({{tr:ballaghta}}), so the ayah measures the mission by whether conveyance reaches completion.
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:ب ل غ}} ({{tr:b-l-gh}}) ranges around reaching, arrival, sufficiency, and completion; Form II selects causing-to-reach

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later negated Form II perfect from the same conveyance root

topics.headline: Form II command to cause the message to reach
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command is not mere speaking but making the sent-down content arrive completely.
topics.reason: Imperative mood, Form II causative force, the open object, and the later negated perfect all make conveyance the ayah's mission-completion test.

words.gloss_range: open relative object; possible process nuance is secondary to the local relative clause
words.prose: {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}) opens the object as what was sent down, leaving no named subset inside the command. A process reading remains grammatically imaginable, but the local relative clause makes the content reading primary; the later {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) turns the same surface sound into negation.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later homographic negator contrasting the open relative object

topics.headline: open object of total conveyance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object is left open as whatever was sent down, while the local syntax mainly supports the relative-content reading.
topics.reason: The rows preserve both relative and process possibilities, but QAC and local attachment make the relative object the governing parse; the later negative homograph remains an audible contrast.

words.gloss_range: passive Form IV perfect: sent-down content foregrounded over the verbal agent
words.prose: {{ar:أُنزِلَ}} ({{tr:unzila}}) defines the object as already sent down. Its passive Form IV perfect foregrounds the received content while the source is supplied afterward, and it keeps the focus on completed descent rather than a staged revealing process.
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:ن ز ل}} ({{tr:n-z-l}}) carries descent, arrival, and lodging/provision imagery; the local form selects completed caused descent

topics.headline: passive descent defines the content to convey
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command concerns content already sent down, with the sender grammatically suppressed but the source named afterward.
topics.reason: The passive Form IV perfect foregrounds received revelation, while local form evidence limits the claim away from a staged Form II descent process.

words.gloss_range: directional phrase marking the Messenger as recipient endpoint
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَيْكَ}} ({{tr:ilayka}}) marks the Messenger as the endpoint of descent. The ayah first routes revelation to him, then through {{ar:بَلِّغْ}} ({{tr:balligh}}) requires outward delivery from him.
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:إ ل ى}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-y}}) functions here as directional endpoint marking rather than an independent lexical image

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: outward conveyance command that follows received descent

topics.headline: recipient endpoint before outward relay
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the Messenger first as the endpoint of descent and then as the relay point for outward delivery.
topics.reason: The preposition plus second-person suffix fixes the destination of descent and joins the from-to transmission channel.

words.gloss_range: source preposition for revealed content
words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) marks source rather than partition. The content to be conveyed is from the Lord, and the later {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) will mirror the preposition with the opposite field: human threat.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later source preposition marking the people as threat-source

topics.headline: source of revelation, not partitive quantity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the revelation as sourced in the Lord rather than as an extracted portion from an undefined store.
topics.reason: The rows converge on provenance and on the later source-preposition contrast with the people as threat-source.

words.gloss_range: construct source phrase: your Lord as the relational origin of revelation
words.prose: {{ar:رَّبِّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbika}}) makes the source relational: it is from your Lord, not an impersonal origin. The root field of nurture, ownership, and completion strengthens the pressure toward complete delivery, while the supplied narrowing variant remains a contrast rather than the local governing text.
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:ر ب ب}} ({{tr:r-b-b}}) ranges around lordship, ownership, nurture, and completion; the local construct binds source to addressee

topics.headline: your Lord as relational source of the command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the source is not impersonal: the command comes from the Lord bound to the addressed Messenger, while variant narrowing remains apparatus-level.
topics.reason: The construct with second-person suffix supports the relational source payoff; the supplied non-base variant would narrow the object, so it is kept as contrast rather than governing the local reading.

words.gloss_range: conjunction linking the imperative to its warning consequence
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins the command to its warning. The conditional that follows is therefore not detached information, but the negative side of the same obligation frame.

topics.headline: conjunction joining command to warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning is attached to the command as the second side of one obligation frame.
topics.reason: The rows support coordination/resumption pressure, with the conditional warning intensifying rather than replacing the imperative.

words.gloss_range: conditional particle opening a remote but statable failure scenario
words.prose: {{ar:إِن}} ({{tr:in}}) opens a severe but remote condition. The grammar can state non-conveyance as a live warning without implying that failure is expected.

topics.headline: remote if-clause for mission failure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that non-conveyance is stated as a severe hypothetical without presenting it as expected.
topics.reason: The selected conditional particle frames an avoidable warning and differs from the prior counterfactual boundary.

words.gloss_range: jussive negator forming the if-not clause
words.prose: {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) negates the possible act and puts the following verb into the governed jussive frame. The warning is compressed into an if-not-doing structure before the result is announced.

topics.headline: negated jussive inside the condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the failure scenario compressed into if-not-doing before the result clause arrives.
topics.reason: The particle negates and governs the imperfect, producing the negative protasis later contrasted with categorical non-guidance.

words.gloss_range: generic jussive action verb with the commanded conveyance recoverable as object
words.prose: {{ar:تَفْعَلْ}} ({{tr:tafal}}) uses the broad action verb instead of repeating the specific conveyance command. With the object recoverable from {{ar:بَلِّغْ}} ({{tr:balligh}}), failure to do it becomes failure to perform the whole transmission duty.
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:ف ع ل}} ({{tr:f-ʿ-l}}) covers doing and acting; locally it subsumes the specific conveyance command

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: specific conveyance command recoverable behind the generic doing verb

topics.headline: generic doing absorbs the conveyance duty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the whole duty is reduced to doing it: failure to act means failure to convey.
topics.reason: The generic Form I action verb, object ellipsis, and echo of the specific command make conveying the deed at stake.

words.gloss_range: answer particle introducing the result clause
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge from condition to consequence. It makes the next negated clause the answer to non-action, not a separate statement placed afterward.

topics.headline: result hinge from condition to verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the next clause is the consequence of failed action, not a loose follow-up statement.
topics.reason: The rows identify the particle as the conditional answer marker that converts the protasis into an if-then warning.

words.gloss_range: negator of the perfect conveyance verb
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) negates completed conveyance. The earlier {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}) opened the scope of what must be conveyed; here the same sound cancels completion if the command is not done.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: earlier relative object whose surface sound contrasts with this negator

topics.headline: negation of completed conveyance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same surface sound that opened the object now returns to cancel completed delivery if the duty is not done.
topics.reason: The negative particle scopes over the perfect verb and contrasts with both the earlier relative object and the later ongoing non-guidance negation.

words.gloss_range: Form II perfect under negation: completed caused-arrival denied
words.prose: {{ar:بَلَّغْتَ}} ({{tr:ballaghta}}) mirrors the imperative as a Form II perfect under negation. The warning says that if the duty is not performed, the message has not been caused to reach as a completed mission.
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:ب ل غ}} ({{tr:b-l-gh}}) ranges around reaching, arrival, and completion; locally the perfect tests whether caused arrival has been completed

topics.headline: completed conveyance annulled by failure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning measures the mission by completed arrival, not by partial effort.
topics.reason: The Form II perfect mirrors the imperative but under negation, making completion of caused arrival the standard for the message.

words.gloss_range: direct object: God's entrusted message, locally singular with variant scope contrast
words.prose: {{ar:رِسَالَتَهُۥ}} ({{tr:risālatahu}}) is the measured payload of the negated perfect: God's message entrusted for delivery. The singular reading presents one unified commission, while plural variant evidence would distribute the scope across communications without changing the divine ownership.
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:ر س ل}} ({{tr:r-s-l}}) ranges around sending, dispatching, and message-bearing; the noun selects the sent payload entrusted for delivery

topics.headline: His message as unified entrusted payload
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object of non-conveyance is God's entrusted message, with singular and plural readings affecting scope but not ownership.
topics.reason: The suffix is locally resolved to God by the source phrase and construct relation; singular/plural variant evidence is preserved as scope contrast rather than a different referent.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction opening the assurance clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) turns the discourse from warning into promise. It opens a fresh assurance clause while keeping the protection answer inside the same flow of command and fear.

topics.headline: resumptive pivot into divine assurance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a structural turn from severe warning to protection promise without leaving the same discourse flow.
topics.reason: The rows support a resumptive reading that opens a fresh assurance clause after the conditional warning.

words.gloss_range: nominative divine name as fronted subject of the protection clause
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) stands first in the protection clause, so the protector is encountered before the threat-source is named. The nominal opening grounds the assurance in God as stable agent.
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) carries worship-authority and turning-for-refuge discussions; locally the proper name grounds divine protection

topics.headline: fronted divine name grounds protection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the protector before the threat: God is placed first as the stable agent of guarding.
topics.reason: The nominal sentence and fronted subject support stable divine agency; root-dispute material is kept as authority/refuge resonance, not as a separate local sense.

words.gloss_range: active imperfect protection with the Messenger as object
words.prose: {{ar:يَعْصِمُكَ}} ({{tr:yaṣimuka}}) makes protection an ongoing divine action with the Messenger as its direct object. The root image of holding back and preserving gives the promise force: God guards the same you who must convey, while broader preservation language remains bounded by this protection context.
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:ع ص م}} ({{tr:ʿ-ṣ-m}}) ranges around guarding, holding back, preservation, and seeking refuge; locally God actively protects the Messenger

topics.headline: ongoing God-given guarding of the Messenger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices protection as an active divine holding-back from human threat, not merely encouragement.
topics.reason: Imperfect aspect, Form I active voice, object suffix, root imagery, and the 11:43 contrast all support protection; preservation-from-error remains a lexical resonance, not an unrestricted doctrine claim.

words.gloss_range: ablative/source preposition after the protection verb
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) marks the source-field from which protection operates. The people are not only recipients of delivery; in this clause they are the danger-source from which God guards the Messenger.

topics.headline: people marked as source of threat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the people are not just the audience but the source-field from which protection is given.
topics.reason: The preposition after the protection verb marks separation from or source of threat and mirrors the earlier source phrase for revelation.

words.gloss_range: definite generic collective: people as public threat field
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nāsi}}) names the threat field generically as people. The protection is scaled to public human pressure, and the 5:44 recurrence turns a command not to fear people into an explicit promise of protection from people.
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:أ ن س}} ({{tr:ʾ-n-s}}) includes sociability/perception discussions, with a disputed forgetfulness alternative; locally the noun names the human social field

topics.headline: generic human field as pressure source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that protection is scaled to public human pressure, not a named enemy alone.
topics.reason: The definite generic noun and 5:44 connection support the public-human threat field; the sociability/forgetfulness root dispute is kept as social-pressure resonance, not a replacement for the local collective meaning.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle opening the closing assertion
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) strengthens the closing assertion. After the Messenger-specific command and assurance, the final clause opens as an emphatic general verdict.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final clause is formally strengthened as a general verdict, not a casual add-on.

words.gloss_range: accusative divine name governed by the emphatic particle
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) repeats the divine name in a new case and role. The same God who protects as {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) is now the governed topic of the verdict about guidance.
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) is the divine-name field; locally the proper name is the governed topic of the verdict

words.gloss_range: negator creating ongoing declarative denial
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) negates the imperfect guidance verb as a standing declaration. It contrasts with {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}): the earlier negation framed hypothetical non-action, while this one states the settled fate of rejectors.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: earlier conditional negator contrasted with categorical non-guidance negation

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a shift from hypothetical non-action to a standing divine non-guidance statement about rejectors.

words.gloss_range: active imperfect guidance verb under categorical negation
words.prose: {{ar:يَهْدِى}} ({{tr:yahdī}}) closes the movement with denied guidance. The active imperfect makes God the one who does not guide the described community, and the {{ar:ه د ي}} ({{tr:h-d-y}}) gift-residue lets the denial feel like withheld direction and withheld benefit while the local sense remains guidance.
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:ه د ي}} ({{tr:h-d-y}}) ranges around guiding, leading, and gift-giving; locally the guidance/leading branch is selected with gift-residue as payoff

topics.headline: standing denial of guidance to the rejecting community
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah lands on a formulaic rule: God does not actively guide the rejecting community, with guidance also felt as a withheld benefit.
topics.reason: The active Form I imperfect under negation, direct object, Surah 5 formula, and closure position support a standing verdict; gift-language is retained as lexical residue within guidance, not the selected translation sense.

words.gloss_range: definite collective direct object of the guidance denial
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقَوْمَ}} ({{tr:al-qawma}}) is the collective object of that denial. The word turns the target into a community standing together, with the following participle locking the reasoned qualifier onto the group.
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:ق و م}} ({{tr:q-w-m}}) ranges around standing, rising, establishing, and people/community; locally it names a collective standing together

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that non-guidance targets a collective stance, not scattered isolated persons.
topics.reason: The noun is the direct object of the guidance verb, qualified by the following participle, and participates in the Surah 5 formula with community types.

words.gloss_range: definite plural active participle qualifying the community as active rejectors
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ}} ({{tr:al-kāfirīna}}) closes the ayah with an active participial class label. Its covering image counters {{ar:بَلِّغْ}} ({{tr:balligh}}): the message is to be made to reach outward, while this group is characterized by covering and resistant closure.
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:ك ف ر}} ({{tr:k-f-r}}) ranges around covering, denial, ingratitude, and covering-over; locally the participle names an ongoing rejecting class

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final label as active covering that opposes the opening command to make revelation reach.
topics.reason: The active participle grammatically qualifies the community and closes the ayah in semantic opposition to conveyance; farmer/night/expiation images remain concrete root support under the theological sense.
